xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2857: Pipeline membership is blind to strike/ branches — active strike work shows as 'backlog, never started' and is hidden from the issue rail

plan.title: Pipeline membership is blind to strike/ branches — active strike work shows as 'backlog, never started' and is hidden from the issue rail
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: resolvePipelineMembership() decides membership from durable lenses, but every lens is blind to strike work during its working phase: issueIdFromRef() (src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts:190) requires a feature/ segment, the two git for-each-ref calls (:210-211) list only feature/* refs, and the candidateHeads/merged-PR fallbacks (:260-268) hardcode feature/<id> head names. An active strike (live strike/pan-XXXX branch, running agent, no PR yet) therefore fails every lens and classifies clean_terminal ('backlog, never started') — invisible in the issues rail, the CommandDeck pipeline board, pan pending, and the flywheel, all of which delegate to this one chain.
narratives.Proposal: Stay inside the durable-lens doctrine: a strike/<id> branch is a durable git artifact the L2 lens should read. Widen issueIdFromRef() to accept feature|strike (which also fixes L1 open-PR head parsing at :241), add strike/* patterns to both for-each-ref invocations, include strike/<id> in the candidateHeads and merged-PR fallbacks, generalize the resolver's branch-live reason wording from 'feature branch' to 'convention branch (feature/ or strike/)', and document strike/ as a recognized convention branch. The resolver's bucket logic is untouched — strike issues surface as planned_backlog before the PR opens and in_flight once it does.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No new IssueLensSignals field or distinct strike-specific reason string/bucket — the shared planned_backlog bucket with generalized wording is the issue's stated minimum
- No changes to resolvePipelineMembership() bucket logic or lens precedence
- No change to PLANNED_BACKLOG_SPEC_ONLY_REASON (PAN-2822 specOnlyPlanned derivation depends on it byte-for-byte)
- No frontend changes — rail and CommandDeck consume the shared membership chain and need nothing
- No changes to other strike-aware surfaces (webhook-handlers.ts strike review-pass, strike-workspace-reaper.ts)
- No live browser UAT with a real strike branch — unit tests plus the existing six-consumer delegation audit prove all surfaces

autoDecisions.summary: Bucket strike-branch issues as planned_backlog with a generalized shared reason string instead of adding a distinct 'active strike branch — awaiting PR' reason.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists planned_backlog as the minimum acceptable option; a distinct reason requires a new branch-kind signal in IssueLensSignals since the resolver only sees booleans, widening the lens interface and every gather/test surface for cosmetic benefit. Visibility — the actual acceptance criterion — is delivered by the bucket.

autoDecisions.summary: Verify the CommandDeck acceptance check via the existing delegation audit rather than live UAT.
autoDecisions.rationale: tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-audit.test.ts mechanically enforces that enumerate-in-flight (CommandDeck's feed) and the other five consumers delegate to resolvePipelineMembership, so a gather-level unit test proves both surfaces at once; creating a live strike branch to eyeball the dashboard adds no coverage.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the L1 open-PR lens for strike heads in the same regex change even though the issue only names L2.
autoDecisions.rationale: issueIdFromRef() is also the parser for pr.headRefName (gather :241); leaving it feature-only would keep an OPEN strike PR invisible, a strictly worse variant of the reported bug. Same one-line change, so it belongs to this issue.

items.title: Recognize strike/ refs in issueIdFromRef and the for-each-ref branch listings

expected_outputs: vitest exits 0 with new strike-ref cases and all pre-existing feature-branch cases green

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts: (1) change the guard in issueIdFromRef() at line 190 from /(?:^|\/)feature\//.test(ref) to /(?:^|\/)(?:feature|strike)\//.test(ref); (2) in the Promise.all at lines 210-211, add 'refs/heads/strike/*' and 'refs/remotes/origin/strike/*' to BOTH for-each-ref invocations (the plain listing at :210 and the --no-merged=main listing at :211) — all four new patterns, matching the existing feature/* pairs. In tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.test.ts, extend the deps() run() mock (lines 49-53) and add cases: a local 'strike/pan-20' and remote 'origin/strike/pan-21' ref produce signals with hasConventionBranch true (and branchUnmerged true when listed by the --no-merged mock); feeding an open-issue strike-branch signal through resolvePipelineMembership (already imported at line 15) returns bucket planned_backlog with inPipeline true; a closed issue with a leftover strike branch returns clean_terminal; an open PR with headRefName 'strike/pan-22' sets hasOpenPr true and resolves to in_flight; a foreign-prefix 'strike/krux-9' ref produces no candidate (extend the 'ignores foreign refs' test at line 126).

items.title: Given a local strike/pan-N or remote origin/strike/pan-N ref in the for-each-ref output, gatherProjectLensSignals returns a signal row for PAN-N with hasConventionBranch true, and when the ref also appears in the --no-merged listing it returns branchUnmerged true

Given an open issue with an unmerged strike branch and no PR, resolvePipelineMembership returns bucket planned_backlog with inPipeline true; given the same branch on a closed issue it returns clean_terminal
Given an open PR whose headRefName is strike/pan-N on the project's own repo, gather returns hasOpenPr true for PAN-N and the resolver returns bucket in_flight
Given a strike/krux-9 ref under the PAN prefix project, gather produces no candidate row for it (foreign-prefix filtering preserved)
npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.test.ts exits 0 with every pre-existing feature-branch expectation unmodified
Include strike/<id> heads in the candidateHeads and merged-PR fallbacks

expected_outputs: vitest exits 0 including a merged-and-deleted strike branch resolving hasMergedPr true

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.ts: (1) at the candidateHeads construction (lines 260-261), change the no-headRefs fallback from new Set([`feature/${id.toLowerCase()}`]) to include both `feature/${id.toLowerCase()}` and `strike/${id.toLowerCase()}`; (2) at the merged-PR fallback loop (lines 266-268), mark mergedPrIssues when mergedHeads has EITHER `feature/${id.toLowerCase()}` OR `strike/${id.toLowerCase()}`. These fallbacks only fire for candidates with no live refs (branch deleted after merge), so this makes a merged strike PR the merge oracle exactly like a merged feature PR. In tests/unit/lib/pipeline-membership-gather.test.ts add: an open issue (from listOpenIssues) with no refs whose listMergedPullRequestHeads mock returns strike/pan-N gets hasMergedPr true and resolves to post_merge_limbo; and update the 'checks merged PR history only for active candidate heads' test (line 163) to expect both feature/ and strike/ fallback heads in the listMergedPullRequestHeads call.

items.title: Given a candidate issue with no live refs, listMergedPullRequestHeads receives both feature/pan-N and strike/pan-N fallback heads for it

Given listMergedPullRequestHeads reports strike/pan-N merged and no local/remote refs exist for PAN-N, gather returns hasMergedPr true and the resolver returns bucket post_merge_limbo for the open issue

For issues with live refs, gather produces a listMergedPullRequestHeads call containing only their exact head names (no fallback heads) and preserves the existing active-candidate-heads test expectations
Generalize the branch-live planned_backlog reason and lens doc comments to both conventions

expected_outputs: vitest exits 0 with the updated reason-string assertion and the byte-identical PLANNED_BACKLOG_SPEC_ONLY_REASON assertion both green

narrative.Action: In src/lib/pipeline-membership.ts: (1) change the branch-live reason at line 139 from 'open issue with an unmerged feature branch but no PR — needs a PR or disposition' to 'open issue with an unmerged convention branch (feature/ or strike/) but no PR — needs a PR or disposition'; (2) update the JSDoc on hasOpenPr (line 40, currently names only feature/<id>) and hasConventionBranch (line 44, currently 'A feature/<id-lowercase> convention branch') to name both feature/<id> and strike/<id> conventions. Do NOT touch PLANNED_BACKLOG_SPEC_ONLY_REASON at line 34 — PAN-2822's specOnlyPlanned DTO derivation and the audit test's byte-for-byte assertion (pipeline-membership-audit.test.ts:81-83) depend on it. Update the verbatim reason assertion at tests/unit/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.test.ts:403 to the new wording. Add one audit-test case asserting the branch-live reason names both conventions.

items.title: resolvePipelineMembership returns the reason 'open issue with an unmerged convention branch (feature/ or strike/) but no PR — needs a PR or disposition' for a branch-live open issue with no PR
PLANNED_BACKLOG_SPEC_ONLY_REASON remains byte-identical — the exact-string assertion in pipeline-membership-audit.test.ts still exits green, preserving the PAN-2822 specOnlyPlanned derivation
The updated assertion in tests/unit/dashboard/server/services/resource-discovery.test.ts matches the new reason wording and npx vitest run on that file exits 0
Document strike/ as a recognized convention branch in PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md

expected_outputs: grep returns a count of at least 1 — the durable-lenses section names strike/<id> alongside feature/<id>

narrative.Action: In docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md, update the 'Durable lenses' section (lines 5-18): state that the convention branches read by lenses 1-3 are BOTH feature/<id> and strike/<id>, and add one sentence that an active strike (live strike/ branch, no PR yet) therefore surfaces as planned_backlog before its PR opens rather than clean_terminal. Keep the bucket table wording ('unmerged convention branch') as is — it is already convention-neutral.

items.title: grep 'strike/<id>' docs/PIPELINE-MEMBERSHIP.md exits 0 — the Durable lenses section states both feature/<id> and strike/<id> as the convention branches the PR and branch lenses read
The doc states that an open issue with a live strike/ branch and no PR surfaces as planned_backlog (in the pipeline) before the PR opens
